items.content_html: Cloud9Resume is a lightweight, responsive, and user-friendly platform to build resumes, portfolios, and check ATS compatibility. The platform supports Free, Starter, Pro, and Pro+ plans with a credit-based AI system. Phase 1 MVP focuses on resume building, portfolio preview, and public ATS checking.
